1.2.2.4-r10.burton_quote: he knew many Monks and Widows, grievously troubled with melancholy, and that from this sole cause

1.2.2.4-r12.burton_quote: tells a story of an ancient Gentleman in Alsatia, that married a young wife, and was not able to pay his debts in that kind for a long time together, by reason of his several infirmities: but she because of this inhibition of Venus, fell into a horrible fury, and desired everyone that came to see her, by words, looks, and gestures, to have to do with her
1.2.2.4-r12.translation: He was seized with colic pain and many diseases, and fell sick almost as soon as they were married ... and when they would not consent, she loudly demanded English mastiffs.
